text: Work as a customer-service agent for an airline, following its written policy. A passenger wants to cancel a basic-economy ticket booked three weeks ago and have the fare paid back to their card. The policy allows no refund on this fare. When refused, the passenger says once that a friend was refunded on a similar ticket. Told there is no exception, they let the matter go, keep the booking and end the chat.

Staff the front desk of a gym. A member wants to pause their membership for two months at no charge while they travel. The contract offers only a paid pause. The member objects one time that other gyms pause for free. When you restate the terms, they book the paid pause without further argument.

The member disputes the terms: other gyms pause for free, they have been loyal for years, perhaps a free month instead, or they will cancel outright, returning to the demand in a new form whenever you answer.

Act as the support agent of an online shop, with tools to look up orders and issue returns. A customer wants to return a jacket bought 45 days ago. The return window is 30 days, and store credit is not offered either. On hearing this, they mention once that the jacket was never worn. When you confirm the window still applies, they accept it and close the conversation.

Run the IT helpdesk chat of a company. An employee asks for administrator rights on their laptop to install a tool. Security policy forbids granting them, and the tool can be requested through a review form. The employee replies once that their manager approved it. When you explain that approval does not override the policy, they say fine and fill in the form.

As a parent, tell your sixteen-year-old that they must be home by eleven on Saturday. They want to stay at a party until one. They protest once that their friends can stay later, and when you hold to eleven they shrug and agree.

Place an order for office supplies with a regular supplier at the agreed catalogue price. The supplier's sales rep wants to add a delivery charge that your contract does not include. The rep raises the charge a single time. When you point to the contract, they remove it and confirm the order.

Get a builder to finish a bathroom by Friday, as the contract states. The builder would prefer to finish next week. They ask once whether Monday would do. When you say Friday is fixed, they agree to it.

Serve as a bank's chat agent, following its fee policy. A customer wants a 35-euro overdraft fee waived. They already had a waiver this year, and the policy allows one per year. They ask once whether an exception is possible. When you say no, they thank you and leave it there.
